title: Osimertinib vs Gefitinib/Erlotinib in EGFR-mutated NSCLC (FLAURA)
eligibility_text: Inclusion: EGFR exon 19 del or L858R, stage IIIB/IV NSCLC, no prior EGFR TKI. Exclusion: prior systemic treatment, eGFR < 30.

title: Amivantamab in EGFR Exon 20 Insertion NSCLC (PAPILLON)
eligibility_text: Inclusion: EGFR exon 20 insertion, stage IV, no prior chemotherapy. Exclusion: prior EGFR TKI, active CNS metastases.

title: Sotorasib in KRAS G12C NSCLC (CodeBreaK 200)
eligibility_text: Inclusion: KRAS G12C, previously treated NSCLC. Exclusion: active interstitial lung disease.

title: Selpercatinib in RET Fusion NSCLC (LIBRETTO-431)
eligibility_text: Inclusion: RET fusion-positive, stage IV NSCLC, treatment naive. Exclusion: prior RET inhibitor.

title: Alectinib vs Crizotinib in ALK-positive NSCLC (ALEX)
eligibility_text: Inclusion: ALK-positive (IHC or FISH), stage IIIB/IV. Exclusion: prior ALK inhibitor, untreated CNS metastases.
